_doc: Priorities from client-usage.md table surfaces; unused=skip. Done means covered by real Connection tests. Partial notes list known limits.

agentSessions.import.note: tests/agent_sessions.rs: imports transcripts of the last 30 days (max 100) as threads with the last 200 text messages and the native session id so the provider resumes; idempotent. Tool calls and thinking are not reconstructed; transcripts are never written.

agentSessions.scan.note: tests/agent_sessions.rs: scans $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/projects and $CODEX_HOME/sessions (bounded files/bytes/line length, read-only, nothing cached), groups by directory, reports matching projects and alreadyImported.

assets.createUrl.note: Real-client tests cover all resource tags including native-app-icon (app-id/display-name), tool-output-image and credentialed github-media, plus Range/HEAD and signed grants. Still partial: MCP app HTML injection, full native icon theme/platform discovery, media types/host adapter parity and cache cleanup.

assets.persistChatAttachments.note: No client call site in inventory.

attachments.createUploadUrl.note: Real-client test (files_assets): HMAC-signed 10 min grant, type/size limits (10 MiB image, 50 MiB file), pending-<uuid>[-ext] ids. Token layout matches T3.

attachments.delete.note: Real-client test: removes pending uploads (and .txt sidecar), idempotent, ignores non-pending or malformed ids. Upload route: streamed to a .part file, exact size, 204, 409 on conflicting duplicate.

cloud.getRelayClientStatus.note: No client call site in inventory.

cloud.installRelayClient.note: No client call site in inventory.

device.action.note: tests/device.rs real t3-protocol client with fake adb on PATH: connected authorized local Android discovery, configure, sessions, detail, PNG screenshots, key input and subscription cancellation. No boot/shutdown, emulator creation, iOS, SSH/EAS, tool installation, H264 video, full detail/settings or action parity; unsupported operations return typed reasons. Per-subscription polling only while subscribed; no idle adb process. Desktop with installed decoder does not fall back to PNG.

filesystem.getMetadata.note: Real-client test: file/directory/null, header MIME sniff for extensionless files, batch limit of 64.

git.preparePullRequestThread.note: tests/pull_requests.rs: fetches pull/N/head from origin into refs/o3/pull/N, local mode refuses a dirty tree, worktree mode leaves the root checkout alone. GitHub remotes only.

git.resolvePullRequest.note: No client call site in inventory.

git.runStackedAction.note: Real-client tests cover commit/push/PR progress, scoped blank-message deterministic fallback, validation and cancellation during a running hook (no commit or surviving descendant). PR operations require gh; unavailable CLI returns an error. hook_* events accepted as unused by the reader sweep; see CONFORMANCE.md.

guestShare.create.note: Guest links need T3 Connect (out of scope); answers GuestShareCreateError(disabled) and guestSharingEnabled stays off. tests/admin_reads.rs.

mcpApps.callTool.note: o3-server runs no MCP app host; answers McpAppRequestError(provider-unsupported). tests/admin_reads.rs.

mcpApps.readResource.note: o3-server runs no MCP app host; answers McpAppRequestError(provider-unsupported). tests/admin_reads.rs.

mcpApps.toolInfo.note: No client call site in inventory.

orchestration.dispatchCommand.note: Remaining: native attachment steering, full attempt/provider-thread identity, background/subagent settlement, exact inference reattachment (native-session continuation with a new turn is implemented; process-kill peers in tests/active_recovery.rs) and native delivery acknowledgement. Persistent exact-operation consent and both native plan acceptance flows have real-client peer coverage; broad native permission rules/revocation UI remain unsupported.

orchestration.getArchivedShellSnapshot.note: Real-client test: archived threads and projects with the shared sequence. Built from the in-memory shell assembly (10,000 thread cap), same limit as the live shell.

orchestration.getFullThreadDiff.note: Real Connection Codex execution captures Git refs and verifies baseline-to-turn diff. Checkpoint retention and overlapping-workspace isolation remain.

orchestration.getOlderSettledThreads.note: tests/admin_reads.rs: pages settled top-level threads below the cursor (settledAt desc, id asc), limit 0 returns per-project counts, project filter. Snapshots never omit older settled threads, so capabilities.shellOlderSettled stays false.

orchestration.getThreadFamily.note: No client call site in inventory.

orchestration.getThreadProjection.note: Real-client test: bounded projection (up to 100 rows per kind) and an error for unknown threads.

orchestration.getTurnDiff.note: Real Connection Codex execution captures baseline/end refs using a private Git index; test verifies diff over a real workspace change. Includes untracked nonignored files and deletions; non-Git workspaces report unavailable.

orchestration.getTurnItem.note: Real-client test: item by id for its own thread, null otherwise. The revision argument is ignored.

orchestration.getWorkflowScript.note: tests/admin_reads.rs: reads .js files below $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR|~/.claude/projects, 256 KiB cap, T3's typed OrchestrationGetWorkflowScriptError reasons.

orchestration.getWorktreeThreadIds.note: No client call site in inventory.

orchestration.launchThread.note: Real-client tests/provider_input.rs covers owned worktree/branch rollback after SQL failure, retry receipts, reused empty-thread workspace metadata, preserved title/model and refusal of occupied threads. Remaining: reused launch initial-message model override, imported-native-thread/generateTitle preparation parity. SQL launch remains transaction-atomic.

orchestration.searchThread.note: Real Connection + isolated nightly 3991 differential: literal transcript message/plan search, case folding, index/start/offset, wrap and bounded navigation implemented. tests/thread_commands.rs verifies ordering and isolation. Rich markdown/context/skills segmentation and folded-answer exclusion remain; not full conformance.

orchestration.searchThreadStream.note: No client call site in inventory.

orchestration.searchThreads.note: Real-client tests cover match metadata (threadId/projectId/source/snippet/messageCreatedAt/messageId/hits/quality), supplemental thread shells and snapshotSequence, project filters and olderSettledBefore/environmentLabel. Still partial: FTS prefix matching/ranking differs from upstream substring/folded text and title ranking; returned matches are consumed.

orchestration.stopWorkflow.note: No provider control stops a workflow; answers OrchestrationV2StopWorkflowError(unsupported). tests/admin_reads.rs.

orchestration.subscribeArchivedShell.note: No client call site in inventory.

orchestration.subscribeCommandOutput.note: Real Connection tests verify bounded command tails/replacement/final output. Real Claude Bash results and Codex command/outputDelta frames emit Command events. Claude output arrives at tool completion; no full VT folding.

orchestration.subscribeShell.note: Real-client tests cover repositoryIdentity replacement snapshots/resolved roots, timestamps, active plans, subagent summaries and client cursor/replay invariants (tests/thread_commands.rs). Remaining client-read gaps: native background-task lifecycle and usage-limit reset/failure status. Independent-operation interleavings are accepted per CONFORMANCE.md.

orchestration.subscribeThread.note: Real-client native peers cover attempts, provider-thread links, context usage, item ordinals; thread_commands.rs verifies snapshot-before-tail, increasing sequence, ordered replay and the real client projection reducer. Remaining: complete native background lifecycle/recovery and pre-binding provider-thread identity. Independent-operation interleavings are accepted per CONFORMANCE.md.

preview.clearProfile.note: tests/preview.rs: accepted as a no-op; the server holds no browser profile data to clear (profiles live in the client that renders the preview).

projectClone.start.note: tests/admin_reads.rs: git clone of remoteUrl or github owner/name, blocks until it ends (capabilities.projectCloneTracking stays off, no progress stream); refuses non-empty destinations and removes a failed clone.

projects.createNew.note: tests/admin_reads.rs: creates <base>/projects/<slug> (atomic claim, -2.. suffixes), git init, README, assets/icon.svg, first commit (commitError reported, not fatal), then the project. Folder slug folds common Latin accents only (no full NFKD).

projects.ensureScratch.note: No client call site in inventory.

projects.listEntries.note: No client call site in inventory.

projects.listIgnoredFiles.note: tests/admin_reads.rs: git ls-files --others --ignored --directory, files only, 200 max, lstat sizes; non-repositories answer an empty list.

projects.mutate.note: Real-client RPC/HTTP tests cover validated create/update/delete, receipts, root creation/duplicates, repositoryIdentity from local Git remotes, shell replacement after remote changes, and transactional force-delete of thread shells. No network required for repository identity. See tests/threads_compat.rs and tests/files_assets.rs.

projects.readFile.note: Real-client test: relative paths rooted lexically and by realpath (symlink escapes refused), 1 MiB cap with truncated flag, binary refused, allowMissing, absolute host paths read in place as T3 does, filesystem:read scope.

projects.searchContents.note: No client call site in inventory.

projects.searchEntries.note: Real-client test: git ignore rules, kind/imageOnly filters, limit clamp, truncated flag, missing root error. Ranking is o3's own (basename, then path, then subsequence), not T3's fff finder; index capped at 25,000 entries.

projects.writeFile.note: No client call site in inventory.

server.refreshUsageRates.note: tests/admin_reads.rs: answers pricing status 'unavailable' (no price list is fetched or bundled), same as getUsageSummary.

server.removeKeybinding.note: tests/keybindings.rs: upsert/remove persist only the user's rules in keybindings.json (atomic write), T3's 82 default bindings are served and replaced per command, shortcuts/when expressions validated, malformed files reported as issues and never overwritten. getConfig now returns keybindings/issues.

server.reportClientActivity.note: tests/ops.rs: validated, kept per client until its ttl; nothing consumes it yet (no background policy).

server.runStorageCleanup.note: tests/ops.rs: removes profile log files older than 14 days; worktree and browser-artifact cleanup do not exist.

server.setAcpRegistryProvider.note: No client call site in inventory.

server.signalProcess.note: tests/ops.rs: SIGINT/SIGKILL only to descendants matching pid and start time.

server.uninstallAcpRegistryManagedBinary.note: No client call site in inventory.

server.updateServerWithProgress.note: No client call site in inventory.

server.updateSettings.note: Connection tests: provider instance create/upsert/remove, redacted environment preservation, entry replacement/null removal, directory history, primitive type checks. Full upstream normalization/model preferences/background policy remain.
